verdict.rationale: Bitbucket documents Rovo AI access 'in your terminal or IDE' and AI-powered pipeline workflows/AI code review, plus an official Atlassian MCP server that could let AI agents issue natural-language commands, but there's no dedicated evidence of a chat-style natural-language command interface for core Bitbucket actions (PRs, branches, permissions) or independent confirmation it works end-to-end. Missing for 10: concrete examples of natural-language command execution across core repo/PR workflows, hands-on validation of Rovo's NL capabilities, and confirmation the MCP server exposes broad command coverage.
